result.title: CVTSplat: Multi-view Reconstruction Using an Adaptive Centroidal Voronoi Tessellation
result.summary: Voronoi tessellations have recently emerged as an adaptive, space-partitioning discretization for shape and appearance reconstruction from multi-view images. However, the irregular cells they produce make the repeated reconstruction of the tessellation during optimization costly. We therefore explore adaptive centroidal Voronoi tessellations (CVTs), which extend standard CVTs with non-uniform cell sizes while preserving the regular, well-shaped cells that make them efficient to compute. In CVTSplat, cell size is modulated by the evolving signed distance field, concentrating sites near the zero level set while keeping cells nearly centroidal. This regularity lets us specialize the whole pipeline, with GPU algorithms for nearest-neighbor queries and approximate Voronoi construction, and a rasterizer tailored to small, nearly isotropic cells. Our Voronoi construction is 5 to 10 times faster than general-purpose alternatives in this regime. On DTU and BlendedMVS, CVTSplat reaches geometric accuracy competitive with the best Gaussian-splatting surface methods while training in about 2.5 minutes on a single GPU.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 CVTSplat，用自适应质心 Voronoi 划分（cell 大小由演化中的 SDF 调制）从多视角图像重建形状与外观，并配套 GPU 最近邻查询、近似 Voronoi 构建与专用光栅化器，在 DTU 与 BlendedMVS 上以约 2.5 分钟单卡训练达到有竞争力的几何精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按学习到的场非均匀分配 cell 尺度、把表示容量集中到关键区域的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent/token 预算的自适应分配提供表示几何方面的类比线索，但属推测，需核查是否可迁移。
